answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities by making each name post a time-locked bond and pass a live replay audit before it can earn or vote. Random peers re-run one recent job and require the output to mirror the claimed trace within a tight hash bound; failure slashes the bond, so a swarm of shells burns capital and compute for every fake. New accounts remain under a saffron probation cap with tiny limits, and only after repeated audits and elapsed lock time is a violet standing mark issued that counterparties can check before they trade.
